name: XFCE
description: Lightweight full desktop in its own window (via Xephyr on WSLg).

install.apt: DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y xfce4 xfce4-goodies xserver-xephyr dbus-x11
install.zypper: zypper --non-interactive install -t pattern xfce && zypper --non-interactive install xorg-x11-server-extra
install.apk: apk add xfce4 xfce4-terminal xorg-server-xephyr dbus-x11
